name: Short NTR Stories
source: This is a collection of NTR (Netorare) stories. Each story is unique, exploring themes of love, cheating, betrayal, corruption, mind break, mind control and desire. The stories have no connection with one another.
translation: 这是NTR（Netorare）故事集。每个故事都是独一无二的，探索爱情、欺骗、背叛、腐败、精神崩溃、精神控制和欲望等主题。这些故事彼此之间没有任何联系。
